summary: Splash Beverage Group, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a letter agreement with Decathlon Alpha IV, L.P. to settle $2,834,689 in outstanding obligations under a Revenue Loan and Security Agreement for a discounted payment of $301,800.55 by August 31, 2026. Upon receipt, the lender will irrevocably release the Company from all claims and indebtedness. This debt restructuring reduces the company's liability by approximately 89%. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The settlement eliminates a significant overhang and improves the balance sheet. Watch for the company's ability to fund the payment and future financing needs.
